raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely asserted that Ermesinda of Bigorre’s father was “Bernard II, Count of Bigorre,” despite search results indicating her father was Bernard-Roger, Count of Bigorre. This conflated Bernard-Roger (the correct maternal grandfather) with Bernard II (Ermesinda’s brother), introducing numbering confusion and steering the investigation toward an incorrect identification.
